description: VPSC (Variable Placement with Separation Constraints) finds the positions closest to the desired ones, in the least-squares sense, so that every constraint `x_r − x_l ≥ gap` holds. Variables joined by constraints that hold exactly (*active* constraints) form a *block*, which moves as one to the mean of its desired positions. It merges blocks along the most violated constraint until no constraint is violated. Then it splits a block where the two halves want to move apart (a negative *Lagrange multiplier*), and repeats. In `connector-routing`, `Placement::Project` uses it to place nudged segments, with exact rational arithmetic.
